assurance_domains.title: Source identity and reproducibility
assurance_domains.proves: The named public capsule and pinned reviewer computation have bounded source, dependency, and replay instructions with first-party verification targets.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: Independent execution, scientific validity, field performance, or fitness for a buyer's production environment.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Obtain and verify one protocol-matched non-author execution receipt.

assurance_domains.title: Evidence custody and claim governance
assurance_domains.proves: The public verifier checks declared capsule structure, custody, manifests, resource boundaries, and bounded claim states.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: That a self-authored input is substantively true, independently validated, safe, or authorized for release.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Bind a buyer-owned source, baseline, metric, and decision owner to a signed sprint scope.

assurance_domains.title: Security reporting and disclosure
assurance_domains.proves: The public repository defines a private vulnerability-reporting route, supported-version boundary, and best-effort response process.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: A response-time guarantee, bug bounty, penetration test, security certification, or independently audited security program.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Agree buyer-specific severity, notification, remediation, and disclosure terms before handling confidential data.

assurance_domains.title: Repository and reviewer-suite supply chain
assurance_domains.proves: The named reviewer suite has hash-locked dependencies and a scoped inventory; the current exact 43-file public release has deterministic CycloneDX 1.6 file coverage and pinned workflow actions. The retained successfully verified GitHub OIDC/Sigstore provenance and SBOM attestation set covers the historical 30-file release at commit 5fff567c11bee65b5b1de5415d8b8935cd2dfab0, not the current release.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: A complete product SBOM, VPS operating-system or gateway inventory, continuous vulnerability management, vulnerability status, a SLSA level, production dependency approval, or live deployment parity.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Inventory the deployment runtime, establish vulnerability triage and exception handling, periodically re-verify trusted roots, and assess any SLSA level separately.

assurance_domains.title: Public deployment identity
assurance_domains.proves: A fail-closed exact-snapshot release and audit protocol exists in source.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: That lumen-core.ai currently matches the checked-out commit or that its runtime and gateway are production-certified.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Run the human-gated exact-snapshot release and retain a successful current-commit live audit receipt.

assurance_domains.title: Buyer data rights and handling
assurance_domains.proves: The bounded sprint templates require source authorization, handling terms, retention, access, and acceptance details to be agreed before work.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: An executed data-processing agreement, universal license to buyer data, regulated-data authorization, or legal sufficiency.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Complete buyer-specific data classification, rights confirmation, handling schedule, retention plan, and legal review.

assurance_domains.title: Identity, access, and runtime activation
assurance_domains.proves: Source and tests define a default-deny operator API boundary and a separately gated gateway repair path.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: That production secrets are installed, the live gateway is repaired, identity is enterprise-federated, or access controls were independently tested.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Execute the separately authorized runtime repair, verify secret ownership, and retain current live negative-access tests.

assurance_domains.title: Incident response, continuity, and recovery
assurance_domains.proves: A bounded first-party incident policy, severity model, authority boundary, deterministic CI tabletop, and read-only live release classification path are documented and machine checked.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: A tested live recovery exercise, completed production restoration, customer notification performance, enterprise SLA, business-continuity or disaster-recovery certification, or external audit.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Run a separately authorized live restoration exercise, retain rollback and current-commit verification receipts, and negotiate buyer-specific incident, continuity, backup, restoration, and notification terms.

assurance_domains.title: Legal, certification, and insurance review
assurance_domains.proves: The public materials preserve founder IP and separate technical evidence from legal, patent, and certification conclusions.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, regulatory approval, legal approval of the offer, patent scope, or adequate commercial insurance.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Obtain buyer-specific legal, IP, insurance, regulatory, and certification review before any production or regulated engagement.

assurance_domains.title: Commercial scope and delivery
assurance_domains.proves: One bounded offer, non-confidential fit intake, proposed price bands, delivery boundaries, and a buyer-specific SOW template exist.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: Buyer acceptance, a signed paid scope, cleared payment, booked revenue, successful delivery, or market-tested pricing.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Secure one qualified buyer, signed scope, authorized source, accepted baseline and metric, and cleared initial payment.

assurance_domains.title: Independent execution and external validation
assurance_domains.proves: A bounded non-author execution handoff, receipt contract, and external replication docket are prepared.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: Evaluator assignment, evaluator independence, completed non-author execution, scientific validation, certification, or field validation.
assurance_domains.next_gate: A qualified non-author evaluator must execute the locked protocol and return a verifiable completed receipt.

assurance_domains.title: Privacy and regulated-data boundary
assurance_domains.proves: The public repository excludes private records and the sprint schedule requires buyer-specific data classification and handling decisions.
assurance_domains.does_not_prove: HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, export-control, classified-data, CUI, or other regulated-data authorization or compliance.
assurance_domains.next_gate: Keep the first fit review non-confidential; obtain applicable privacy, jurisdiction, export, and regulated-data approval before intake.
